channel.title: Violations Watch: Philippines
channel.description: New incidents reported in Philippines. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Philippine police arrest and detain at least 245 people protesting the US president's visit around the ASEAN summit in Manila; lawyers say 19 children among the detained (HRW, NUPL)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines. Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Philippine National Police. Disputed or caveats: Number of children per the National Union of Peoples' Lawyers. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1006
